But if you've found him—we've got to go.|Quinlan Vos and Asajj Ventress|}} '''Raxus Secundus''', also known simply as '''Raxus''', was a lush [[Planet|world]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Tion Hegemony]] that served as the [[capital]] planet of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. Renowned for its beauty, Raxus had a [[Temperature|temperate]] climate and was covered with [[ocean]]s and landmasses. Since the [[Separatist Senate]] was [[Separatist Senate Building|headquartered]] within its capital [[city]] of [[Raxulon]], Raxus became home to a number of Confederate [[senator]]s, including [[Mina Bonteri]] of [[Onderon]]. Other major Raxian cities included [[Tamwith Bay]], which was located a considerable distance from Raxulon. Raxus was a contested world throughout the Clone Wars, and its strategic importance led the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems Navy|Confederacy navy]] to [[blockade]] it to oversee security for incoming travelers. Nevertheless, [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] Senator [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]], seeking to meet with Bonteri, were able to smuggle themselves onto Raxus aboard a [[Gozanti-class cruiser|transport]] from [[Mandalore]]. [[Count]] [[Dooku]], the leader of the Confederacy, visited Raxus for various events, and it was during one such [[Raxian Humanitarian Award|award]] ceremony that [[Jedi Master]] [[Quinlan Vos]] and [[bounty hunter]] [[Asajj Ventress]] launched a [[Mission to Raxus Secundus|failed attempt]] to [[assassin]]ate him. After the war, Raxus found itself in the crosshairs of the Republic's successor, the [[Galactic Empire]], which committed the [[Antar Atrocity]] to pressure Raxus and other worlds into surrendering all former Separatists to Imperial custody. Raxus Senator [[Avi Singh]], who refused to voice support of the Imperial occupation, was arrested and later extracted by the [[Clone Force 99|Bad Batch]]. ==Description== {{Quote|So, where are we heading?''"
"''Raxus.|Ahsoka Tano and Padmé Amidala|}} [[File:RaxusLandscape-HOBS.png|thumb|left|250px|A pastoral world, Raxus was known for its beauty.]] The [[planet]] Raxus was situated in the [[Raxus system]], a [[star system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[sector]] of [[Realspace|space]] that was known as the [[Tion Hegemony]]. A verdant terrestrial world that [[orbit]]ed a [[Star|sun]], Raxus supported a temperate climate and an [[atmosphere]] that was breathable to a number of [[humanoid]] [[species]]. Its climate was comfortable despite a challenging ecosystem and dangerous [[Diet|predators]]. Its surface was covered by vast [[ocean]]s and landmasses, which themselves were enveloped by [[Tree|forests]], plains, and hills. Raxus's lushness led it to become known for its beauty. By the [[time]] of the [[Clone Wars]], some areas on the world were heavily developed, such as the urban sprawl of its capital [[city]], [[Raxulon]], while regions that were farther from the city center remained more rural. ==History== ===Under the Republic=== {{Quote|Larik was using a Senate seat to become rich at the expense of our people and planet.|Semage referring to Larik|}} [[File:Raxus_guard_with_blaster.png|thumb|right|270px|Larik was caught in his corrupted dealing by his own bodyguards.]] At some point, long before the Clone Wars, [[Larik]] became the [[Senator]] of the world. As senator, Larik was using his position to get rich by luring off-world companies and industries under the pretext to industrialise the land. When [[Raxus guard|Larik's bodyguards]] learnt of Larik's true intentions, [[Semage]], [[Hanel]] and a few bodyguards tried to force him to put forth the [[bodyguard]]s' own intentions at the next Senate Hearing. In the process, [[Jedi Master]] [[Katri]] died.{{TOTJ|Choices}} Before the next Senate Hearing the Bodyguards were hopeful of, the Jedi Council sent Jedi Master [[Dooku]] and [[Mace Windu]] in a [[T-6 shuttle|T-6 Shuttle]] to the world to retrieve Master Katri's body for a proper burial at the planet [[Coruscant]]. When arriving on the world at a building that later became the [[Separatist Senate Building]] on a landing platform, Dooku wanted to first hear Senator Larik's testimony of the attack that killed Master Katri before retrieving Katri's body. Under threat from his bodyguards, Larik told the Jedi a lie that a group of rebels threatening war led to Larik coming to Raxus and visiting them in a nearby forest. The rebels however ambushed them leading to Master Katri dying. Still not convinced, Master Dooku wanted to see the area where the supposed attack occurred. The bodyguards reluctant to show them, butted in the conversation and offered them to show the area where the ambush occurred. [[File:DookuWinduEnGarde-Choices.png|thumb|left|270px|Dooku and Windu uncover the truth of Katri's death.]] After reaching the area, Dooku and Windu questioned the Senator about the attack. Sensing that the Senator was lying, Dooku ignited his [[lightsaber]] and said that he "will have the truth." Scared, Larik ran to the Jedi claiming that the bodyguards killed her before being killed by the guards. This led to an eruption of blaster fire where the 2 Jedi managed to kill all the Security Droids sent to kill them and captured Semage and Hanel. Undeterred, Hamel reached for his blaster and failed to kill Windu and died. Devastated, Semage told the Jedi the truth. When Windu asked why Semage didn't bring this to the authorities, he asserted that the Jedi were lapdogs at the [[Galactic Senate]]'s bidding and only protected the rich/ powerful instead of the poor. Windu and Dooku then arrested Semage and a few bodyguards then placed them in a prison in a building that later became the location of the [[Separatist Senate]] during the Clone Wars. While at the prison, Dooku talked to Semage and told him that his "ideology, while faulty does have its points." Windu after entering the prison cells block asked Dooku to come with him where they returned to their T-6 Shuttle with Master Katri's coffin. ===Capital of the Confederacy=== {{Quote|Keep your eye on the comm channels.''"
"''On it. I hope Sumdin's clearance code is accurate, or this could get very interesting very quickly.''"
"''It will be. Sumdin is thorough. Transmitting now.|Asajj Ventress and Quinlan Vos, approaching the Separatist blockade of Raxus|}} [[File:SeparatistSenate-HOBS.png|thumb|right|270px|As the Confederate capital, Raxus served as the headquarters of the Separatist Senate.]] Two [[Standard year|years]] prior to the [[First Battle of Geonosis|outbreak]] of the Clone Wars, Raxus and its system attained [[The galaxy|galactic]] prominence when Dooku, now a former Jedi Master who had mostly receded from the [[Galaxy|galactic]] spotlight, returned to the public [[eye]] by commandeering a HoloNet station in the system. Delivering a fiery [[Raxus Address|rhetoric]], he condemned the rampant corruption within the [[Galactic Republic]] and established a separatist state known as the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], effectively sparking a [[Separatist Crisis]] that led a host of worlds, including Raxus, to flock to his new government. With Raxus as its capital world, the lush world served as the headquarters of the Separatist Senate, a civilian legislature comprised of delegates from the Confederacy's member worlds. A number of Confederate senators, including [[Mina Bonteri]] of [[Onderon]],{{Databank|mina-bonteri|Mina Bonteri}} had spoken for their planets in the Republic Senate and took up residence on Raxus to attend Senate sessions in Raxulon's Separatist Senate Building. Though Dooku mostly remained off-world to direct the Confederacy's war effort, he presided over Senate sessions via [[hologram]] and returned to Raxus for important events. Due to its strategic importance, a sizable [[Raxus Secundus defense fleet|armada]] of [[warship]]s from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems Navy|Confederacy navy]] [[blockade]]d Raxus for most of the war, restricting incoming access based on a system of clearance codes. At one point, the blockade included a [[Providence-class Dreadnought|''Providence''-class Dreadnought]], a [[Recusant-class light destroyer|''Recusant''-class Commerce Guild destroyer]], three [[Munificent-class star frigate|''Munificent''-class star frigates]], and a trio of [[Lucrehulk-class battleship|Droid Control Ships]]. ===Republic–Confederate peace talks=== {{Quote|Surely there's room in the galaxy for Confederate and Republic planets to coexist. I move that we immediately open peace negotiations with Chancellor Palpatine on Coruscant.|Bonteri moves to discuss peace with the Republic|}} [[File:BonteriAmidalaMeet-HOBS.png|thumb|left|270px|Padmé Amidala and Mina Bonteri discuss peace between the Republic and Confederacy on Raxus.]] At least a year into the war,{{TCWcanondates|310}} Republic Senator [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] journeyed to Raxus with [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]] to meet with Bonteri, who had mentored Amidala in the realm of [[politics]], in the hopes of bringing about a [[Confederate–Republic peace initiative|peaceful end]] to the conflict. Circumventing the Republic Senate's [[Republic Senate non-communication law|law]] against communication with the Separatists, Amidala and Tano reached Raxus aboard a [[Gozanti-class cruiser|transport]] from [[Mandalore]].{{StoryCite|story=Pursuit of Peace (short story)|book=The Clone Wars: Stories of Light and Dark}} Once they had arrived at a [[Unidentified Raxus Secundus spaceport|spaceport]] in Raxulon, Bonteri helped them evade the [[spaceport]]'s [[B1-series battle droid]] security and brought them to her [[Bonteri house|palatial estate]], located away from the city center. After agreeing with Amidala on the necessity of restoring diplomatic channels between the Republic and the Confederacy, Bonteri invited Amidala and Tano to a following Senate session in Raxulon, where Bonteri convinced her fellow delegates to open negotiations with the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor]], [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]]. Their objective completed, Amidala and Tano set off to return to the Republic capital of Coruscant, and Bonteri and her son, [[Lux Bonteri|Lux]], saw them off from the Raxulon spaceport. However, Dooku thwarted Bonteri's peace initiative by having [[General]] [[Grievous]] execute a [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid|bombing]] on Coruscant, ensuring that the Republic Senate rejected the offer for negotiations, and the [[Sith Lord]] thereafter had Bonteri [[Death|murdered]].{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}{{TCW|A Friend in Need}} Toward the end of the conflict's third year, the Confederacy selected Dooku as the recipient of the [[Raxian Humanitarian Award]] and subsequently organized a high-class gala on Raxus in his honor. By that time, the [[Jedi High Council]] had targeted Dooku for [[assassin]]ation and had assigned the task to Jedi Master [[Quinlan Vos]], who—on the Council's orders—enlisted the aid of Dooku's jilted [[Sith apprentice|apprentice]]–turned–[[bounty hunter]], [[Asajj Ventress]], for his mission. Upon learning of the award ceremony from the [[Information broker|informant]] [[Sumdin]], Ventress [[Mission to Raxus Secundus|voyaged]] to Raxus with Vos aboard her [[starship]], the [[Banshee (starship)|''Banshee'']], to fulfill their objective. After bypassing the Confederacy's orbital blockade and purchasing proper [[Clothing|attire]] in the Raxian city of [[Tamwith Bay]], Ventress and Vos proceeded to Raxulon and, using passes that Sumdin had provided, infiltrated the [[Raxulon plaza square|plaza square]] that was hosting the gathering. They waited until after Dooku had given his acceptance speech for the award to [[Lightsaber combat|engage]] the count in a vicious [[lightsaber duel]]. Yet, thanks in part to support from General Grievous, Dooku defeated his assailants, capturing Vos and forcing Ventress to flee from Raxus. ===Reintegration into the Empire=== {{Quote|The Empire is not your enemy. We promise to treat all planets within the Confederacy of Independent Systems fairly. All we asked in exchange was for your loyalty. Yet that has not been forthcoming here on Raxus.|[[Captain]] [[Bragg]]|{{TBB|Common Ground}}}} [[File:Occupation_of_Raxus.png|thumb|right|270px|The Empire occupied Raxus.]] As the war continued and pressed into its final days after over three years of open hostilities,[[Kanan 1|''Kanan'' 1]] Raxus became a contested planet and lost its status as a safeworld for members of the Separatist Senate, many of whom began meeting in a secretive catacomb system that had been used before the Separatist Crisis instead. The planet also lost running water.''[[Reign of the Empire: The Mask of Fear]]'' The Clone Wars came to an end with successive deaths of Dooku and Grievous, coupled with the [[Mission to Mustafar|execution]] of the [[Executive Separatist Council|Separatist Council]] and the deactivation of the [[Separatist Droid Army]], cementing the Confederacy's defeat. The Republic, meanwhile, was [[Proclamation of the New Order|reshaped]] into the first [[Galactic Empire]] under the newly christened [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] Palpatine.{{Film|III}} Before [[Separatist Reintegration Day]], which brought former CIS planets into the Empire, the planet still lacked running water. The Empire occupied Raxus. While a rise in incursions on Raxus did occur,{{TBB|Common Ground}} no formal, large-scale insurrection happened. After those rise in incursions, Captain Bragg addressed the inhabitants in the city Raxulon on a podium located at the former Separatist Senate Building that the inhabitants should not fear the Empire. Knowing that the inhabitants listened to Senator [[Avi Singh]], the Empire forced the Senator to become a puppet for the empire where he was forced to tell the inhabitants to listen to the Empire. Unable to do this, the Senator instead said that he could no longer condone the Empire's unjust occupation. This led to [[Captain]] [[Bragg]] forcibly removing the Senator. The speech the Senator made sparked protests among the inhabitants leading to the Empire using [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]]'s to force the citizens to comply. After the incident, [[GS-8]] contacted [[Ciddarin Scaleback]] and required her assistance leading to the Bad Batch being sent to Raxus. The [[Marauder (Omicron-class)|Marauder]] when entering Raxus's airspace was pursued by 2 [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter]]s demanding that they send their clearance codes provided by GS-8. The codes worked and the Bad Batch landed in a forest close to the city Raxulon. After meeting with GS-8, the Batch entered Raxulon undetected and reached [[Avi Singh's residence]]. They later infiltrated the building and freed Avi Singh before being tortured by an [[IT-O interrogation droid|IT-O Interrogator]] under the orders of Captain Bragg. While freeing the Senator, the clone troopers stationed in the city were notified of intruders leading to several clone troopers and AT-TE's attempting to corner the Batch. This failed with the Batch infiltrating an AT-TE. After being pursued by the Empire and no way to escape, the Batch went into an alleyway and used a [[thermal detonator]] to blast their way into a subterranean passage that led to a forest far from Raxulon. The Batch managed to reach to the Marauder and after a few heartful words from [[Echo]], convinced the Senator to come with them to the planet [[Ord Mantell]]. ===Imperial target=== Raxus still housed a host of ex-Separatists and became a target of the fledgling Empire, as did other former Confederate worlds like [[Kooriva]] and [[Murkhana]]. Such was the case that a year into the Empire's reign, [[Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] was dispatched to make an example of [[Antar 4]], a [[moon]] that had been allied to the Confederacy for the duration of the Clone Wars. Adhering to his orders, Tarkin made no effort to differentiate Antar 4's Separatists from Imperial-loyal intelligence agents and resistance fighters who were awaiting exfiltration. His forces subjugated the moon, subjecting its entire populace to swaths of arrests and massacres. The [[Antar Atrocity]], as the media termed the event, served to compel Raxus and other worlds to surrender all former Separatists to Imperial custody, or else suffer a similar demise to that of Antar 4. Over the next four years, the Empire acquired possession of the discarded materiel on Raxus, along with similar caches that had been found on an array of other contested worlds, including [[Utapau]]. [[Imperial Intelligence]] consequently compiled an inventory of all the items obtained from the stockpiles. By [[3 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa's]] birth in [[19 BBY]]. The events of ''[[Leia, Princess of Alderaan]]'' commence just after Organa's sixteenth [[birthday]], which places the events of the novel in [[3 BBY]]. Raxus had fallen into a major debt to the Empire; with no other way to pay the amount it owed, Raxus became one of many planets to surrender its remaining autonomy to the Imperial state, firmly placing it under the Empire's control.''[[Leia, Princess of Alderaan]]'' ==Inhabitants== {{Quote|Ahsoka, this is Mina Bonteri. She was my mentor when I was growing up on Naboo.''"
"''You're a Separatist?''"
"''Well, of course, my dear. What were you expecting? Now, come, I have a transport waiting.|Padmé Amidala introduces Ahsoka Tano to Mina Bonteri on Raxus|}} [[File:BonteriEstate-HOBS.png|thumb|left|250px|Bonteri's family lived in a palatial estate on Raxus.]] As the capital world of the Confederacy, Raxus hosted a range of species, among them, including [[human]]s, [[Gossam]]s, [[Siniteen]], [[Rodian]]s, [[Gotal]]s, [[Twi'lek]]s, and [[Pantoran]]s. The planet was also home to an array of Separatist senators, including Mina Bonteri of Onderon, who moved there with her family in order to represent Onderon in the Separatist Senate. Numerous travelers of various backgrounds visited Raxus, though they had to provide the appropriate clearance code in order for the Confederate orbital blockade to grant them access to the world. Security patrols of [[battle droid]]s required further identification from visitors once they arrived at one of the spaceports on the surface. ==Locations== {{Quote|We need to make a quick stop in Tamwith Bay.''"
"''Tamwith Bay? I thought Dooku's party was being held in Raxulon.''"
"''It is. We have to purchase clothing first. Tamwith Bay is still a major city, but it's quite a distance from Raxulon. There will be less security.|Asajj Ventress and Quinlan Vos|}} ===Raxulon=== [[File:Ciscapitalcity.png|thumb|right|250px|Raxulon's urban sprawl contained the Separatist Senate Building within its prominent city center.]] Regarded for its beauty, Raxulon served as the capital city of Raxus. Located on one of the world's landmasses, Raxulon was built around a city center whose tall buildings dwarfed the surrounding urban sprawl. One of the central structures was the Separatist Senate Building, which was situated at the edge of a circular courtyard amidst the spires of neighboring establishments. A network of streets branched out from the city center, and some of them terminated at the outskirts of the city, which remained less developed with their hills, plains, and forests. The Bonteri family estate was situated away from the city center amidst the surrounding hills. Local air traffic within Raxulon was busy but not overly congested, with numerous [[airspeeder]]s, [[shuttle]]s, and [[transport]]s traveling cross-city on a [[Standard day|daily]] basis. As far as spaceports, Raxulon boasted a [[Raxulon main port|main port]] in addition to an array of local landing platforms that were not used as frequently, though the local docks were serviced by [[droid]]s that supplied [[fuel]], cleaning, and other amenities to incoming starships. Asajj Ventress and Quinlan Vos used one such landing pad when they landed in Raxulon aboard the ''Banshee''. The spaceport where Padmé Amidala and Ahsoka Tano arrived aboard a ''Gozanti''-class [[cruiser]] was protected by security [[squad]]s of B1 battle droids that requested arriving travelers to provide proper identification. ===Tamwith Bay=== One of Raxus's major cities, Tamwith Bay was located a fair distance away from Raxulon and had less security than the capital. Among the establishments within Tamwith Bay was a clothing store that featured upscale attire. Ventress and Vos visited the store to acquire suitable outfits for the expensive Raxian Humanitarian Award ceremony in Raxulon. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Raxus_concept_Glenn.png|thumb|left|240px|Concept art for Raxus by Chris Glenn]] {{Quote|For Raxus, The capital world of The Separatist, George ''[Lucas]'' wanted us to think of the capital as a land of perpetual autumn, a place of beauty as opposed to the obvious "bad guys' homeworld" idea.|Pat Presley|{{ArtStation|username=phattro|name=[[Pat Presley]]|url=artwork/ba4nm|date=2014-10-17|text=Raxus Capital City - Star Wars The Clone Wars|quote=For Raxus, The capital world of The Separatist, George wanted us to think of the capital as a land of perpetual autumn, a place of beauty as opposed to the obvious "bad guys' homeworld" idea. First piece, I used Ralph McQuarrie's unused concept painting for Coruscant as inspiration and literally repainted his painting with more Gothic and world specific elements added to it. By tracing Ralph's footsteps, I've gained so much understanding for his image-making process. Note the "After RMQ" signature. Second concept, this piece was inspired by Tolkien's Illustration of Mirkwood from The Hobbit as well as some of the old Disney vibe of Eyvind Earle, or the "Ave Maria" sequence from Fantasia. Done in 2009 for Clone Wars Season 3.|archivefile=File:PatPresley-RaxusSecundus-ArtStation.png}}}} The planet Raxus was created for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' animated television series and debuted in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]] episode "[[Heroes on Both Sides]]," which aired on [[November 19]], [[2010]].{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode310.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Heroes on Both Sides}} The world drew its name from [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]], a junk world that was featured in various [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] projects such as the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]]s [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''The Clone Wars'']] ([[2002]]) and [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed|''The Force Unleashed'']] ([[2008]]).[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' video game]]''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'' The episode's [http://www.starwars.com/tv-shows/clone-wars/heroes-on-both-sides-episode-guide guide] on [[StarWars.com]] stated that the relationship between Raxus and Raxus Prime had yet to be defined, though they were undeniably intended to be different worlds based on their distinct compositions. In the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the name "Raxus Secundus" was given in the [[Star Wars Helmet Collection 11|eleventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Helmet Collection]]'' magazine, published in [[2016]].{{HelmetCollectionCite|11|Databank A-Z}} Within the Legends continuity, [[Jason Fry]]'s [[2014]] [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide|''The Clone Wars: Episode Guide'']] originated the name "[[Raxus Secundus/Legends|Raxus Secundus]]" to further distinguish the world from Raxus Prime.''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]'' Concept art of the planet was designed by [[Pat Presley]] in [[2009]]. ''[[Star Wars]]'' creator [[George Lucas]] wanted to differentiate the planet from the typical evil looking "bad guys' homeworld" stereotype and instead advised the artists to think of a beautiful land in a perpetual season of autumn. Presley first repainted an old unused concept painting for Coruscant by [[Ralph McQuarrie]] with [[Wikipedia:Gothic architecture|gothic]] and the specified elements. For his second painting he took inspirations from [[Wikipedia:J. R. R. Tolkien|J. R. R. Tolkien]]'s illustration of the [[Wikipedia:Mirkwood|Mirkwood]] in ''[[Wikipedia:The Hobbit|The Hobbit]]'' and the work of [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney Animation]] artist [[Wikipedia:Eyvind Earle|Eyvind Earle]] and the "Ave Maria" sequence from ''[[Wikipedia:Fantasia (1940 film)|Fantasia]]''. In [[July]] 2015, Raxus was featured in author [[Christie Golden]]'s [[2015]]] canon novel ''[[Dark Disciple]]'', which was adapted from an eight-episode story arc that was developed for the ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series. The episodes were not completed on account of the series' cancellation in [[March]] [[2013]],{{SW|url=news/a-new-direction-for-lucasfilm-animation|text=A New Direction for Lucasfilm Animation}} though the story arc's first four episodes reached the animatic stage of production.{{WebCite|url=http://www.denofgeek.com/us/books-comics/star-wars/246503/star-wars-interview-christie-golden-talks-dark-disciple|text=Star Wars Interview: Christie Golden Talks Dark Disciple|author=Crouse, Megan|date=2015-06-02|quote=So for my research I watched all of the episodes of ''The Clone Wars'' and the ones with these characters in them multiple times. I also was given the animatics for the first four episodes and the scripts for all eight.|archivedate=20180621024707}} Prior to the novel's release, StarWars.com published concept art for a Raxus landing platform that had been designed for the original episodes by [[Andre Kirk]] and finished on [[April 20]], [[2012]].{{SW|url=series/dark-disciple-concept-art-gallery|text=''Dark Disciple'' Concept Art Gallery}} Other concept art of Raxus was also done by [[Chris Glenn]].{{ArtStation|username=chrisglenn|url=artwork/dO4Ow1|name=[[Chris Glenn]]|text=STAR WARS The Clone Wars / Environments & Vehicles|date=2019-02-20|quote=Another small selection of work from my nearly 6 years at Lucasfilm Animation. I started at the very beginning of Season 4 of Clone Wars, and then through Season 6. I want to send a shout-out to the Production team that supported our crew of 14 concept designers, we never could have done it without you. Truly unspoken heroes that keep the train on the tracks every day.|archivefile=File:ChrisGlenn-TCWconcept-2-ArtStation.png}} The novel identified the planet's capital city as Raxulon, which had appeared in "Heroes on Both Sides" but went unnamed. Raxus Secundus later re-appeared in the episode "[[Common Ground]]" from the [[The Bad Batch Season 1|first season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'', released in [[2021]], and the ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (television series)|Tales of the Jedi]]'' episode "[[Choices]]" in [[2022]]. [[2020]].{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/common-ground-episode-guide|text="Common Ground" Episode Guide - The Bad Batch}} An image depicting [[Raxus Prime]] was used to depict Raxus in ''[[Star Wars:
